title: Zesty Mexican Avocado Salad
description: A tangy, juicy Mexican salad that balances creamy avocado with crisp pickle relish, all finished with a splash of lime and vegan butter for a subtle buttery note-perfect for a ketofriendly, vegan lunch.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine diced avocados, cucumber, red onion, cilantro, tomato, and pickle relish.
2. Drizzle in olive oil and softened vegan butter, tossing gently to coat the vegetables lightly without mashing the avocado.
3. Sprinkle cumin and chili powder over the mixture, then season with salt and pepper. Toss again until evenly seasoned.
4. Squeeze fresh lime juice over the salad and give one final gentle toss to distribute the citrus flavor.
5. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed—add a dash more lime juice, salt, or pepper.
6. Let the salad rest for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld; avocado will slightly soften and brown less due to citrus.
7. Serve chilled or at room temperature on a bed of mixed greens or wrapped in lettuce leaves for an extra crunch.
8. Garnish with a few extra cilantro leaves or a drizzle of extra vegan butter for an indulgent finish.
